Class CardDraftHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.CardDraftHandler
public class CardDraftHandler extends Object
Executes card-drafting actions of a round.

This handler owns the rules behind chooseCard and extraDrawn. Standard draws consume the upper-row and lower-row quotas earned from the offer space. The extra draw is a single end-of-round draw granted by one building effect and does not consume those quotas.

For standard draws, the handler validates four different concepts:

  • the game must be in progress;
  • the round must be in RoundPhase.PLAYER_DRAWS;
  • the requesting player must be the current player;
  • the chosen card must be present, drawable, and compatible with the player's remaining row quota.

Building affordability is checked through the board drawability rules. A building card is drawable only if the player can pay its effective food cost, including builder discounts. After that validation, this handler pays the cost and adds the building to the player's tribe.

Character cards are added to the player's tribe with the overload that receives the player, because some character and building effects react immediately when a character is drawn.

When a standard draft turn ends, the player leaves the offer path for the starting tile, and that placement contributes to the next round order. The exact destination depends on why the turn ended:

  • a connected player who drew, or who simply had no useful card left to draft, returns to the first available starting block via Board.returnPlayerToStartingTile(Player) (a normal completion);
  • a disconnected player has their draft turn force-closed and is sent to the last available starting block via Board.movePlayerToLastStartingTile(Player), so they start the next round in the worst position.

The extra draw is different: the eligible player is already on the starting tile because the standard draft is over. Drawing the extra card, or disconnecting during the extra-draw turn, simply moves the round to RoundPhase.RESOLVING_EFFECTS.

This class does not resolve lower-row events, reset the board, or compute final scoring. It only moves the round phase to the next high-level step when drafting is over.

  • Method Details

    • chooseCard

      public void chooseCard(Player player, int cardId)
      Makes the current player draw one standard card from the board.

      The method receives a card identifier because clients cannot safely send Java model objects over the network. The board converts the identifier into the actual card object currently visible on the board.

      Parameters:
      player - player choosing the card
      cardId - identifier of the selected card

    • extraDrawn

      public void extraDrawn(Player player, int cardId)
      Makes the current player draw the single end-of-round extra card.

      The extra draw is not a standard draft turn. It does not consume upper or lower draw quotas and it does not move the player on the board. After the card has been validated, removed, and applied, the round becomes automatic by switching to RoundPhase.RESOLVING_EFFECTS. The public Game.extraDrawn(Player, int) method then asks PassiveRoundPhaseHandler to continue the passive phases.

      Parameters:
      player - player choosing the extra card
      cardId - identifier of the selected card

    • skipExtraDrawn

      public void skipExtraDrawn(Player player)

    • handlePlayerDisconnection

      public void handlePlayerDisconnection(Player player)
      Handles a disconnection during the standard draft phase.

      If the disconnected player is the current player, their draft turn is closed immediately and the handler advances to the next connected player who can draw. If the disconnected player is not current, the board is not changed here: the automatic advancement will close their turn only if the cursor later reaches them while they are still disconnected.

      Parameters:
      player - player who disconnected

    • handleExtraDrawPlayerDisconnection

      public void handleExtraDrawPlayerDisconnection(Player player)
      Handles a disconnection during the single-player extra-draw phase.

      The extra-draw player is already on the starting tile, so there is no board cleanup to perform. If the disconnected player is the current extra draw player, the optional action is skipped and the round moves to the passive effect-resolution phase.

      Parameters:
      player - player who disconnected
